response_text:

So Adams County's median household income estimate is **$91,387 ± $1,470**. ACS margins of error are published at the **90% confidence level**, so the interval is roughly **$89,917 – $92,857**.

Note that the MOE is a separate variable (`B19013_001M`), not an attribute of the estimate column — the `_E`/`_M` suffix pairing is the ACS convention for estimate and margin of error. (If you want the standard error instead: SE = MOE / 1.645 ≈ 894.)
